Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

October 12th 1916

Sir,
General Yang has granted $1,000 for distribution
among the troops under his command.
General Lu of Woosung visited General Yang
at noon on the 11th inst to discuss with him certain
transfers of troops to Peking.
It is reported that the Arsenal received
telegraphic instructions from Peking on the 11th
inst to manufacture a large number of automatic pistols
which are to be issued to the Police at Peking and the
North during the winter months.
Ling Sz Fong a military detective with
headquarters at No.1 Ling King Road said to be
in the pay of General Chang Hsun, left Shanghai for
Hsuchowfu by the morning train on the 11th inst.
The Repatriation office and the residences of
the rebel leaders are constantly being visited
by destitute rebels who are clamouring for monetary
assistance. As a result the rebel leaders have
addressed a long letter to General Yang pressing for
the immediate distribution of the funds.
There is still no settlement of the painters
strike.
A German named E.H.Eickhoff who has an office at
16 Kiukiang Road passed through Nankin en route for
Peking at the end of last week.

Your Obedient Servant,

William Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

stat 12-10-16）

1916年10月12日

编号
上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股。）

1916年10月12日

先生：

杨将军已拨出1,000元，用于在其麾下部队中分发。

本月11日中午，吴淞的卢将军拜访了杨将军，与其商讨向北京调动部队的事宜。

据报，兵工厂于本月11日收到来自北京的电报指示，要求制造大量自动手枪，以便在冬季月份配发给北京及北方的警察。

军事侦探凌子芳（Ling Sz Fong，音译），其总部设在灵肯路1号（No.1 Ling King Road），据称受张勋将军资助，已于本月11日乘早班火车离开上海前往徐州府。

遣返办公室以及叛乱首领的住所不断有贫困的叛乱分子前来造访， clamouring for monetary assistance（喧闹着要求金钱援助）。因此，叛乱首领们已向杨将军递交了一封长信，敦促立即分发这笔款项。

油漆工罢工事件仍未解决。

一名德国人E.H.Eickhoff，其在九江路16号设有办事处，于上周末途经南京前往北京。

您顺从的仆人，

威廉·阿姆斯特朗
首席侦探督察。

警察总监。

（批注：录入于1916年10月12日的每日统计第7项）
（批注：D/E）
（批注：AM）
